column1: # clues.tsv for Piscine Reloaded ex03 (find_sh.sh) — repeats Shell 01 ex02

Recursively locate files whose name truly ENDS in the .sh extension (not merely contains it, so a foo.sh.backup must be left out), then reduce each match to its bare basename with the extension peeled off — mind that the path and the suffix both have to go.
